product.title: Day Tour to Paronella Park, Lake Barrine and Millaa Millaa Falls

description.text: In Cairns, this Atherton Tablelands historic day covers a guided visit to Paronella Park plus Lake Barrine, Millaa Millaa Falls, and the Curtain Fig Tree. The published format is a castle-and-waterfall circuit rather than a food-and-wine tasting van. The format suits visitors who want those four stops in one coach day without assembling park entry independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cairns, and the itinerary stays on Paronella Park, Lake Barrine, Millaa Millaa Falls, and the Curtain Fig Tree that define this outing rather than a Cape Tribulation beach day.

start.description: Hotel pickup from published hotels in Cairns, Palm Cove, Trinity Beach, and Clifton Beach.

end.description: Return to the Cairns meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
